date: Apr 20, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-20T10:09:30+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Full respecification and revival: title changed to 'Serve historical block hashes from state', description added, status Stagnant -> Draft, six co-authors added; parameters replaced with FORK_TIMESTAMP, HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS 0x25a219378dad9b3503c8268c9ca836a52427a4fb, HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW 8192 and BLOCKHASH_OLD_WINDOW 256; introduces the 8192-slot ring buffer, process_block_hash_history (including a fork-block backfill of up to HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW-1 ancestors), resolve_blockhash, the EVM assembly and bytecode of the contract, the synthetic-address deployment transaction, EIP-158 handling, and additional SLOAD gas charges for BLOCKHASH.; Classification rationale: Wholesale rewrite of the normative specification, parameters, data layout and gas semantics; the largest single change in the EIP's history.; Confidence: high; Commit: d9dbe9cc0e13fabd686ad35c72eb342be06b3498; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d9dbe9cc0e13fabd686ad35c72eb342be06b3498/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d9dbe9cc0e13fabd686ad35c72eb342be06b3498/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Apr 23, 2024; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-24T06:25:37+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Contract assembly changed from 'push2 0x2000 / mod' to 'push2 0x1FFF / and' for the ring-buffer index computation.; Classification rationale: Changes the normative contract implementation (modulo replaced by bitmask) that clients must reproduce byte-for-byte.; Confidence: high; Commit: f942eba3d9590ce593deacb37e285edef71cf164; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/f942eba3d9590ce593deacb37e285edef71cf164/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/f942eba3d9590ce593deacb37e285edef71cf164/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: May 03, 2024; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-05-03T17:59:23+05:30; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Contract input validation restricted from 'inputsize > 32' to 'inputsize > 8' to prevent overflow in the range checks, the overflow comment updated, and a TODO noting the bytecode still reflects the first version (PR #8514).; Classification rationale: Changes the accepted calldata shape of the history contract and therefore its interface; the accompanying TODO records that the published bytecode and derived address were not yet regenerated.; Confidence: high; Commit: c8f44c4e7b77c6c5f6c84151d74afde7da2de3c3; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c8f44c4e7b77c6c5f6c84151d74afde7da2de3c3/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c8f44c4e7b77c6c5f6c84151d74afde7da2de3c3/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: May 03, 2024; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-05-03T17:54:54+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Input validation reworked again: instead of checking calldatasize, the contract compares the right-padded 32-byte calldataload against the maximum 8-byte value (push8 0xffffffffffffffff), with jump targets renumbered, plus a note that callers must left-pad the argument.; Classification rationale: Second step of the same logical input-validation fix started in c8f44c4e; changes the contract interface and the caller-side encoding requirement.; Confidence: high; Commit: ad74c9481f99460301e487ff64f42488116ea47c; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ad74c9481f99460301e487ff64f42488116ea47c/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ad74c9481f99460301e487ff64f42488116ea47c/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: May 17, 2024; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-05-17T23:33:48+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Update for Prague devnet-1: abstract and motivation rewritten around stateless clients; the fork-block backfill loop removed so only the parent hash is written from activation onward (the ring buffer now fills over HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW blocks); resolve_blockhash removed and BLOCKHASH semantics declared unchanged; EIP-158 handling rewritten to deploy the bytecode a la EIP-4788; gas-costs section rewritten around EIP-2929 warming with the BLOCKHASH cost unchanged; backwards-compatibility rewritten; Reference Implementation section removed.; Classification rationale: Removes previously normative behaviour (fork-block history backfill and the modified BLOCKHASH resolution) and changes the gas and compatibility statements.; Confidence: high; Commit: 39480406871a9762472e43cfbc81466c91449d85; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/39480406871a9762472e43cfbc81466c91449d85/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/39480406871a9762472e43cfbc81466c91449d85/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Jun 09, 2024; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-06-09T08:34:54+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: System 'set' operation added to the contract: SYSTEM_ADDRESS parameter introduced, HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS changed to 0x0aae40965e6800cd9b1f4b05ff21581047e3f91e, assembly gains a caller==SYSTEM_ADDRESS branch that sstores calldata at (block.number-1) & 0x1fff, new runtime bytecode published, a 'Contract get and set mechanism' section added, and the deployment transaction, sender and derived address regenerated.; Classification rationale: Adds a new normative code path to the system contract and changes its address and bytecode.; Confidence: high; Commit: 9fcafab5f0111c69666291f62640722e0be88ebb; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/9fcafab5f0111c69666291f62640722e0be88ebb/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/9fcafab5f0111c69666291f62640722e0be88ebb/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Jun 09, 2024; value: 8; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-06-09T13:07:10+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: BLOCKHASH_OLD_WINDOW renamed to BLOCKHASH_SERVE_WINDOW (value 256 unchanged) and reordered in the parameter table; abstract gains 'no impact on BLOCKHASH resolution mechanism'; the block-processing text states clients may alternatively perform the update via a system call to the contract's set mechanism; gas-costs section clarifies that normal EVM semantics apply to contract calls and that BLOCKHASH costs are unaffected.; Classification rationale: Renames a normative parameter and materially clarifies which update mechanisms are permitted and what the gas impact is; classified clarification because no behaviour is added or removed, substantive because implementers must track the renamed constant and the permitted alternative update path.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 19f1818bd059bb4632219120554c7f7eed3d62b7; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/19f1818bd059bb4632219120554c7f7eed3d62b7/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/19f1818bd059bb4632219120554c7f7eed3d62b7/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Aug 21, 2024; value: 11; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-08-21T16:01:38+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Update mechanism respecified as a system call: Sina Mahmoodi added as author; a 'Block processing' section requires calling HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS as SYSTEM_ADDRESS with the 32-byte parent hash, a 30,000,000 gas limit and zero value, with the EIP-4788 system-operation conventions (must complete, not counted against the block gas limit, no EIP-1559 burn semantics, silent failure if no code); new 'EVM Changes' and 'Block hash history contract' sections define the get and set operations; the direct state write is demoted to an alternative documented in a new 'Inserting the parent block hash' rationale section.; Classification rationale: Redefines how the history is written, adds normative system-call requirements, and specifies the contract's get/set interface.; Confidence: high; Commit: 117933b21665ca7c0d040835a9d19b4a02392f47; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/117933b21665ca7c0d040835a9d19b4a02392f47/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/117933b21665ca7c0d040835a9d19b4a02392f47/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Jan 09, 2025; value: 12; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-09T14:27:32+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Brought in line with the sys-asm system-contract implementation: HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW changed from 8192 to 8191 and HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS to 0x0F792be4B0c0cb4DAE440Ef133E90C0eCD48CCCC; the get operation now reverts when calldata is not exactly 32 bytes and reverts (instead of returning 0) for out-of-range requests; the assembly is replaced by the lightclient/sys-asm listing using mod, the standalone runtime-bytecode line is dropped, the deployment transaction/sender/address are regenerated, and a 'Size of ring buffers' rationale is added.; Classification rationale: Simultaneously changes a normative parameter, the contract's error behaviour and its address/bytecode; classified normative_behavior because the revert semantics change is the widest-reaching element.; Confidence: high; Commit: 4c94526b2234d2eb9f127df1f396adb2a0cfbd48; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/4c94526b2234d2eb9f127df1f396adb2a0cfbd48/EIPS/eip-2935.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/4c94526b2234d2eb9f127df1f396adb2a0cfbd48/EIPS/eip-2935.md

date: Feb 12, 2024; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-6110 under 'Included EIPs'. date: Jan 18, 2024; value: 1; event_kind: considered_for_inclusion; Normalized state: CFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-01-18; Historical label: prioritized in the next fork / placed in the draft Meta EIP's 'CFI' bucket; Normalization rationale: ACDE#179 (2024-01-18) minutes summary: 'All EL teams agreed that 2537, 6110 and 7002 should be prioritized in the next fork... given 2/3rd of these EIPs also involve the CL and we didn't get a formal +1 from them, I've put all 3 in the "CFI" bucket for now' (draft PR ethereum/EIPs#8121). date: Feb 12, 2024; value: 1; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-6110 under 'Included EIPs'. ACDE#181 minutes state the cross-layer EIPs were 'moved... to include[d] once the CL devs plus one[d] them', and ACDC#126 (2024-01-25) records broadly positive CL client support for EIP-6110 in Electra. No single minuted moment of the CL '+1' between the draft PR (2024-01-18) and the merge (2024-02-12) was located, so the merged document is used as the definitive record. Pre-EIP-7723 'Included' = commitment to the upgrade's scope; normalized to scheduled_for_inclusion (see the 2024-09-27 section-rename evidence).; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/92daa1df9f48c0f1edf945ed516a1d696fadb5fc/EIPS/eip-7600.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/92daa1df9f48c0f1edf945ed516a1d696fadb5fc/EIPS/eip-7600.md

date: May 07, 2025; value: 8; event_kind: included; Normalized state: Included; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2025-05-07T10:05:11Z; Historical label: Included EIPs (Pectra mainnet activation, epoch 364032 / timestamp 1746612311); Normalization rationale: Pectra activated on Ethereum mainnet at the timestamp recorded in EIP-7600's Activation table (tentative mainnet time added 2025-04-03, commit 355b3350; 1746612311 = 2025-05-07T10:05:11Z). After activation the Meta EIP moved to Final and renamed its EIP list from 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' to 'Included EIPs' (commit 78b50371, 2025-06-09) and changed its abstract from 'Scheduled for Inclusion' to 'Included' (commit 8877eaa7, 2025-06-23).; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de/EIPS/eip-7600.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de/EIPS/eip-7600.md

date: Feb 12, 2024; value: 1; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-02-12T15:36:22Z; Historical label: Included EIPs; Normalization rationale: The initial merged version of EIP-7600 lists EIP-7002 under 'Included EIPs'. ACDE#181 minutes state the cross-layer EIPs were 'moved... to include[d] once the CL devs plus one[d] them', and ACDC#126 (2024-01-25) records broadly positive CL client support for EIP-7002 in Electra. No single minuted moment of the CL '+1' between the draft PR (2024-01-18) and the merge (2024-02-12) was located, so the merged document is used as the definitive record. date: Feb 14, 2025; value: 15; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-02-14T03:16:16+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Status moved to Last Call (deadline 2025-02-21) together with substantial specification updates: the consensus-layer constant is renamed MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_ELECTRA; the standalone 'Block processing' section is folded into 'System Call' which now states the call happens at the end of block processing; the consensus-layer change list is revised (process_pending_balance_deposits -> process_pending_deposits, apply_deposit -> process_deposit with state.pending_deposits, is_aggregator item dropped, process_consolidation added, exit-churn usage limited to 256 ETH with the surplus deferred to consolidations) and now links the pinned consensus-specs Electra beacon-chain document; the rationale is restructured into headed sections, 'Removing the initial slashing penalty' becomes 'Making the initial slashing penalty negligible', a 'Consolidation contract parameter values' rationale explains TARGET=1 and MAX=2 and the 262,144-request queue limit, backwards compatibility is broadened beyond the consensus layer, and a 'Consolidation queue hard limit' security section is added.; Classification rationale: Renames a normative constant, revises the consensus-layer change list and adds new normative limits alongside the status change.; Confidence: high; Commit: 67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/67bfa19fbce58a85919c521c9c95767e7311e886/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Mar 03, 2025; value: 16; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-03-03T11:32:16+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Fee-overpayment guidance extended: the Solidity example gains a requestFeeLimit parameter and a revert when the read fee exceeds it, with a note that the fee can change significantly between transaction creation and inclusion.; Classification rationale: Changes the recommended integration pattern for submitting consolidation requests, which affects implementations built against the contract.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/38ce04bd5da13d450ed34eac9c51913850fa50f8/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Mar 08, 2025; value: 16; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-03-08T21:42:59+00:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Author list extended with Felix Lange (@fjl).; Classification rationale: Frontmatter author-metadata change only.; Confidence: high; Commit: 6097373070b12f44d10d11d5908c42557ee618eb; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/6097373070b12f44d10d11d5908c42557ee618eb/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/6097373070b12f44d10d11d5908c42557ee618eb/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Apr 01, 2025; value: 17; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-02T03:40:03+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: System-call properties and failure directives added: the call is made at CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS as SYSTEM_ADDRESS with no calldata, requests must appear in the EIP-7685 list in the exact dequeued order, the call has a dedicated 30,000,000 gas limit excluded from block gas accounting, does not follow EIP-1559 fee-burn semantics, and the block MUST be invalid if the predeploy has no code or the call fails; 'insert_withdrawal_request_into_queue' corrected to 'insert_consolidation_request_into_queue'; new 'System Call failure' and 'Empty Code failure' security sections added.; Classification rationale: Adds normative block-validity conditions and gas-accounting rules for the system call.; Confidence: high; Commit: 2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe/EIPS/eip-7251.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/2f2f5124962be20bf222d71613c2f415f1e62bbe/EIPS/eip-7251.md

date: Apr 11, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-11T09:12:36+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Move to Draft' (ethereum/EIPs#9237, opened 2025-01-13 by Felix Lange and merged 2025-04-11) rewrites the EIP. Title becomes 'eth/69 - history expiry and simpler receipts' and status returns Stagnant -> Draft; Ahmad Bitar is added as an author; the Status (0x00) message gains earliestBlock, latestBlock and latestBlockHash and moves the block hash to the end; a new BlockRangeUpdate (0x11) message is specified with a send-at-most-once-per- epoch rule; the eth/69 receipt encoding becomes the flat list "[tx-type, post-state-or-status, cumulative-gas, logs]" instead of the legacy or typed forms; new Motivation and Rationale sections cover history expiry, and EIP-7542 is cited as an earlier withdrawn proposal of the same idea.; Classification rationale: Adds a new protocol message and redefines two existing message encodings, changing what eth/69 requires of every client implementation and of the test suite.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6

path.aria-label: date: Apr 17, 2024; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-17T20:01:03+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Simplify cl behavior": removes the requirement that "A additional processing step is be added to process_execution_payload to iterate over and process all requests", leaving each proposal free to choose how to extend ExecutionPayload and "how and when the request is processed".; Classification rationale: Deletes a consensus-layer processing requirement and delegates the decision to each request-type proposal; changes what implementers must do.; Confidence: high; Commit: 0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0e0600ed164db7875be38548bfb26ec24ff78e01

date: Apr 18, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-18T22:38:06+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Substantial specification build-out: renames the CamelCase types to snake_case (request_type / request_data / requests_root); adds a "Block structure" section appending a list of requests to the RLP block body; specifies requests_root computation with explicit compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data pseudocode; adds cross-type and intra-type ordering rationale sections; reflows the prose.; Classification rationale: Defines the block body structure and the header commitment computation that were previously only described in prose; changes the data structures implementers must produce.; Confidence: high; Commit: e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/e2a66831fcc5984f478513ce298607e178c364e8

date: Apr 25, 2024; value: 2; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-04-25T20:32:17+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: "Clarify intra-type ordering": drops the claim that lexicographical ordering of the opaque byte data would be the only valid scheme, keeping the same rule that intra-type order is determined by each request type individually.; Classification rationale: Rationale-section rewording; the normative rule (intra-type order undefined here, set per request type) is unchanged.; Confidence: high; Commit: 67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/67c96916b9714b8ddc917d56705f3f9dfb468126

date: Sep 26, 2024; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-09-25T20:07:15-06:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Change requests hash to flat hash" (PR #8854): replaces the Merkle-Patricia trie requests_root with a flat commitment, renaming the header field to requests_hash and defining compute_requests_hash(list) = keccak256(rlp.encode([rlp.encode(req) for req in list])); also rewords the opaque-byte-array rationale ("transaction payload" -> "request payload").; Classification rationale: Changes the header field name and the commitment algorithm; directly affects block validity computation.; Confidence: high; Commit: 73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/73629679582e2f06f4abfcabfd1c7615bc65df08

date: Sep 26, 2024; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-09-26T07:38:35-06:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Fix stale function name" (PR #8907): the assignment line still called compute_trie_root_from_indexed_data, removed by the previous commit; it now calls compute_requests_hash.; Classification rationale: Repairs the normative pseudocode left inconsistent by the flat-hash change so that the specified computation is unambiguous; same logical update as commit 73629679.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/4dc51ba1e3cdd63439247415da7edf36b32f9e79

date: Oct 07, 2024; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-10-07T22:31:38+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Group requests into request-data": removes the block-body extension entirely (the header alone carries the commitment); redefines a `requests` object as request_type ++ request_data where request_data holds zero or more encoded request objects of that type; replaces the keccak256/RLP commitment with sha256(sha256(requests_0) ++ sha256(requests_1) ++ ...); updates the abstract and the ordering rationale accordingly.; Classification rationale: Changes the block structure, the grouping of requests, and the hash function and construction of the header commitment.; Confidence: high; Commit: a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a360757d75893fb9e7a9c37c98e05481d671f68f

date: Nov 26, 2024; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2024-11-26T21:42:50+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Exclude empty requests data in commitment": items whose request_data is empty (length 1, type byte only) are skipped when building the intermediate hash list; the intermediate list must be ordered by request_type ascending; the pseudocode is corrected to hash digests (m.update(sha256(r).digest())) over a Sequence[bytes] block_requests; adds a rationale explaining that a block with no requests then commits to sha256("").; Classification rationale: Changes which elements enter the commitment and therefore the value of requests_hash; directly affects block validity.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5ac0297b9ac29255e785ff305feea940db5ac6b4

date: Jan 22, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-01-22T17:24:19+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a third per-fork field 'baseFeeUpdateFraction' to the blobSchedule object (example values cancun 3338477, prague 5007716), with a matching Motivation bullet and Rationale sentence; and replaces the fallback rule with a requirement that clients configure target, max and baseFeeUpdateFraction per fork, declaring the behavior undefined and client-chosen when the configuration is missing or incomplete. Frontmatter description is reworded from 'Include a per-fork schedule of max and target blob counts in client configuration files' to 'Include a per-fork blob parameters in client configuration files'.; Classification rationale: Extends the configuration data structure with a new required field carrying the blob base fee update fraction, and simultaneously removes the previously specified default/fallback behavior, replacing it with undefined behavior. Both changes affect what execution clients must read from their configuration files. The merging pull request (#9240, author @MarekM25) carries only the repository's PR-template boilerplate, so no author rationale is on record beyond the diff itself.; Confidence: high; Commit: b3b84e06f7639394165be6cd86bc5298fa9c6706; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b3b84e06f7639394165be6cd86bc5298fa9c6706; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b3b84e06f7639394165be6cd86bc5298fa9c6706

g.aria-label: Title text 'Execution layer EIP revision histories'

Subtitle text 'Primary line: cumulative substantive post-creation revisions. Faint line: all post-creation revisions. Filled inclusion markers are state transitions; open gray markers preserve same-state records. Triangles at panel bottoms are relevant devnets; lower opacity denotes medium-confidence participation. Assessment review lanes from top to bottom: REF, PFI, CFI, SFI, then devnet/testnet markers. Each event type has a fixed lane; the proposal anchor is the amber dashed rule.'

text.tspan: Primary line: cumulative substantive post-creation revisions. Faint line: all post-creation revisions.
Filled inclusion markers are state transitions; open gray markers preserve same-state records.
Triangles at panel bottoms are relevant devnets; lower opacity denotes medium-confidence participation.
Assessment review lanes from top to bottom: REF, PFI, CFI, SFI, then devnet/testnet markers.
Each event type has a fixed lane; the proposal anchor is the amber dashed rule.
